svg.title: Stopped trajectories
svg.desc: Observed illness–death paths with a probability cloud and censoring cuts. Blue: recurrence at 3, observed death at 6, censoring at 8. Orange: censoring at 4 and hidden death at 7.5. Purple: recurrence at 2, censoring at 5, hidden death at 9. Pale dashed portions are illustrative unobserved continuations, not estimates.
